svg.title: VDJmatch: from receptor tables to antigen evidence
svg.desc: Bulk and paired receptor inputs share curated VDJdb searches. Receptor annotation ranks epitope evidence and preserves ambiguity. Repertoire inference compares observed target support with matched mock reference panels. All small charts are schematic, not measured results.

g.text: From receptor tables to antigen evidence
Shared matching machinery, distinct receptor and repertoire questions
Bulk repertoires
Junction · V/J · read counts
Paired receptors
Cell identity · TRA/TRB · orphans
Validate → normalize → search curated VDJdb
Columnar exact / native batched search · full peptide–MHC · retained reference observations
RECEPTOR ANNOTATION
Which epitopes have support?
Sequence neighbourhood
V-gene context + motifs
Schematic reference family
Linked-first paired labels; marginal fallback
Ranked candidates · ties · explicit unknowns
Epitope evidence per receptor
Detection and label assignment remain distinct.
Calls require complete-procedure calibration.
REPERTOIRE INFERENCE
Is target support enriched?
Observed target support
Matched mock references
Schematic endpoint distribution
Declared control, Pgen bins and matching rule
Counts · abundance · full-data discovery curves
Target evidence per repertoire
Empirical P values and explicit test families.
Retain no-hits and unavailable inference.
Python API + CLI · flat evidence tables · reproducibility manifests · report figures
Sequence evidence supports annotation; it does not establish experimental binding.
MATCHING METHODS · distinct geometries, shared batch search
Exact identity d = 0 • Hamming d = Σᵢ 1[qᵢ ≠ rᵢ] (equal lengths)
Levenshtein d = minimum substitutions + insertions + deletions (unit costs)
Positional BLOSUM / PSSM d = Σᵢ wᵢ Δ(qᵢ,rᵢ) + gap cost
Δ(a,b) = B(a,a) + B(b,b) − 2B(a,b); B is the substitution matrix; wᵢ is the position weight.
Stem4 d = 3d(core) + dᵥ + rounded mean of four opposite-end max costs
Junction alignment trims 3 residues per end; dᵥ sums aligned CDR1, CDR2 and CDR2.5 costs.
Stem4 uses untrimmed ends and unclipped BLOSUM62; no extra matrix-maximum scaling.
CURRENT DEFAULT · stem4 geometry + V-bounded kernel
q: query; X: pMHC target; N: fixed target size; tⱼ: shell cutoff; τ: kernel scale.
nⱼ / vⱼ: all / same-V target shell counts; mⱼ: cumulative other-peptide count.
Retained alternatives: historical density; all / same-V-only and rare-background kernels;
V-loop, flank/frame, J/length and positional variants; SW/NW; PAM250, MJ and VDJAM.
REFERENCE PROFILES & REPERTOIRE TESTS · separate statistical questions
V / conditional motif information: KL bits; core3 + masked four-mers; shuffle tails.
Levenshtein / Hamming graphs: communities, coverage, Hill diversity and rarefaction.
PWM motifs: residue-frequency profiles / allowed sets (precursor module; not stem4).
Matched-reference enrichment P = (1 + #{Tmock ≥ Tobserved}) / (B + 1)
T: declared count, abundance or discovery endpoint; B: number of mock reference panels.
Current repertoire null: raw marginal Pgen bins match observed controls; no binding-probability interpretation.
